sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/347 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 347, search/grid facilities 423 'Sites 001-104' and 422 'Sites 105-195' for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for every unit on 2027-06-15, plus sites 002, 017 and 184 on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $37 a night, full hookups $50, the same on a Saturday (June 2027); off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both $33. The 12 non-electric sites 184-195 ($29, $25 off-peak) are grass/dirt sites mapped with tent icons and list no pad or rig length, so they don't set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Dillon campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Campsite Full Hookup 50.00, Campsite Non-Electric 29.00 with no camping unit length, Pad Surface 'Grass/Dirt'; grid MapInfo UnitImage 'Ohio/Units/tent' for 184-195); sites 002, 017, 184 on Sat 2027-06-19 (37.00 / 50.00 / 29.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (33.00 / 33.00 / 25.00), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (165 'Campsite Electric' and 12 'Campsite Full Hookup' sites list Electricity Hookup '50'; the 12 full-hookup sites list Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park-campground ('There are Full Hookup, Electric, and Non-electric sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 177 web-bookable RV sites (165 electric, 12 full hookup), all back-in, rated for camping units 28-64 ft (most 35-45; full-hookup pads 36-45), plus 12 non-electric tent sites (184-195). ODNR counts 195 sites, 2 ADA. A separate equestrian campground (19 non-electric sites and 1 premium electric site with shelter) is on its own road. Pets permitted on all campsites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (423: 102 units, 422: 87 units) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 28-64) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park-campground ('195 sites; 2 are ADA', 'Pets are permitted on all camp sites', 'Equestrian Camping ... located on its own road in the park ... 19 Non-electric sites, 1 Premium site with shelter'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Camp store (740-452-1083) carries camping supplies and groceries. Off-season (November 1 to April 1) only shower house A and the dump station (no rinse water) are open; water from the side of shower house A needs a 75-ft hose.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, and a dump station'; 'Camp Store (740-452-1083) carries camping supplies and groceries'; 'Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1, shower house A and dump station available (no rinse water) Water can be accessed from the side of shower house A and will require a 75' hose.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak (November 1 to April 1) only Area A is open: sites 1-104 and 184-195.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park-campground ('Off-Peak Season: From November 1 to April 1 ... Area A is open and includes sites 1 through 104 and sites 184 through 195.') + ReserveOhio search/grid 2027-01-12 (facility 423: all 102 units free; facility 422: only the 12 sites 184-195 free, 75 blocked), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations are required, up to 6 months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. Every listed campsite is web-bookable with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park ('Reservations are required; reserve online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/dillon-state-park-campground ('Campsite reservations may be made up to 6 months in advance') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees changed: base 29 -> 37 (the $29 non-electric sites are tent sites with no rig length), surcharges electric 8 / full_hookup 21 -> full_hookup 13, added the $33 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the 12 full-hookup sites, 177 back-in RV sites rated to 64 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump/camp store, year-round (Area A only in the off-season), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, reservations required, 14-night max. Pin 340 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (740) 452-1083 (the camp store, listed as the campground's phone); the park office is (740) 453-4377 (8am-4pm Mon-Fri), which the park page also calls the camp office.
Pin 340 m off (200 m from the nearest site). Centroid of ReserveOhio's 189 family-campground site coordinates: 40.00802,-82.10733.
